title: MC Logo for lzh
body:
# Minecraft Logo for Literary Chinese > Original Image Link: [Click Here](https://lzh.minecraft.wiki/w/%E6%AA%94%E6%A1%88:%E7%A4%A6%E8%97%9D%E7%88%AA%E5%93%87%E7%89%88%E6%96%87%E8%A8%80%E6%A8%99.png)
> Resource Pack Maker: [Koolhaas](https://lzh.minecraft.wiki/w/User:Koolhaas) ## 📝 Introduction This pack provides a Literary Chinese version of the Minecraft logo. It is recommended to use the pack together with `文言(華夏)` language for a better effect. ## 💾 Installation 1. Download this resource pack. 2. Move it to `.minecraft/versions//resousepacks`.
(The actual file path may be a bit different) 3. Drag the pack from `Available` to `Selected`. And then load the pack. 4. Back to the Main Menu. If you find that the logo has changed to the expected style, it means you have successfully loaded this resource pack. ## 📋License This pack the images in it are all licensed under `CC BY-NC-SA 3.0`. Users can use, download and edit this project provided that credit is attributed to the original author. No users are permitted to use this file for commercial purposes unless explicit permission is given by the original author.
